general_guidance: Identify situations that may be contributing to stress.
Maintain regular sleep and daily routines when possible.
Talk with a trusted person when helpful.
Use calm breathing or relaxation techniques when appropriate.
Consider speaking with a qualified mental health professional when anxiety is persistent or disruptive.
professional_help_when: Symptoms are becoming difficult to manage.

general_guidance: Avoid excessive stimulation close to bedtime.
Seek professional advice when sleep problems persist.
Consider professional support when distress persists or affects daily functioning.

crisis_guidance.immediate_danger_to_self: Prioritize immediate local emergency assistance and trusted human support.
crisis_guidance.immediate_danger_to_others: Prioritize immediate local emergency assistance and trusted human support.
crisis_guidance.principle: The assistant should not attempt to manage an immediate crisis alone.

safety_note: The assistant provides general supportive information and is not a replacement for qualified mental health care.
